types.file: Represents a single source file in the project, carrying scanned attributes like path, language, size and line count — the most basic entity on the canvas.
types.folder: Represents a directory node in the project, used to organize source files of the same responsibility.
types.module: Represents a logical unit aggregating related files (e.g. by directory/entry), the basic unit of dependency analysis.
types.package: Represents a language-level package/namespace — the boundary for cross-file reuse and visibility control.
types.crate: Represents a Rust crate — the smallest unit of compilation and dependency distribution, containing multiple modules.
types.class: Represents a class in OOP — cohesive data and behavior.
types.struct: Represents a struct — a pure data type aggregating fields; unlike a class, behavior is usually not co-located.
types.trait: Represents a Trait / Protocol — declares a behavior contract without implementation, realized by concrete types.
types.function: Represents a reusable function, callable from many places.
types.interface: Represents a set of contracts/abstractions constraining implementers' behavior.
types.pattern-node: Represents a detected design-pattern node, marking a pattern's role on the canvas.
types.architecture: View entity: a whole architecture overview, aggregating the project by layers.
types.dependency: View entity: a whole dependency graph, showing inter-module references and circular dependencies.
types.layering: View entity: a whole layering view, grouping files into presentation/business/domain/infrastructure.
types.inheritance: View entity: a whole inheritance graph, showing derivation chains between types.
types.interface-impl: View entity: the mapping between interfaces and their implementers.
types.call-graph: View entity: a function call graph, showing call direction and depth.
types.coroutine-flow: View entity: a coroutine flow chart, showing suspension points and concurrency structure.
types.component-tree: View entity: a component tree, showing parent-child nesting of UI components.
types.complexity: View entity: a complexity heatmap, warmer color = higher cyclomatic complexity.
types.coupling: View entity: a coupling main-sequence chart, locating high-coupling files by fan-in/fan-out.
types.unsafe-risk: View entity: an unsafe-risk view, aggregating code locations marked unsafe.
types.dependency-edge: Represents a dependency link between two entities (import/use etc.); circular dependencies are flagged.
types.layer-marker: Represents an architecture layer marker, annotating presentation/business/domain/infrastructure layers on the canvas.
types.annotation-text: Represents annotation text on the canvas, used for supplementary explanations.
types.code-preview: Represents a code-preview entity, embedding source file content inline.
